evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and optimizes JSON serialization in the decodepsbt RPC method.
rationale: Eliminates quadratic key-scanning overhead when serializing partial signatures in `decodepsbt`. Because partial signatures are already uniquely keyed by public key ID in the internal PSBT structure, replacing duplicate-checking map insertions with `pushKVEnd` provides a clean algorithmic speedup for transactions with many signatures.
